entries.title: Show HN: Parabola.io – Automate your work with visual programming
entries.author: alexyaseen
entries.current_title: Show HN: Parabola.io – Automate your work with visual programming
entries.excerpt: Hi HN! I’m Alex from Parabola ( https://parabola.io ). Parabola is a visual programming tool for creating functional data flows that everyone can use. It’s entirely drag-and-drop, handles data sizes much larger than a traditional spreadsheet, calculates everything live, and can run your flows on a schedule of your choosing. I used to work in strategy consulting, doing data analytics for SMBs and Fortune 500 companies. The amount of time wasted on menial tasks was astounding.
entries.guide_zh: Parabola 用拖拽搭建数据处理流程，让日常数据工作可以自动执行。
